text: Large, gently handled curds are salted in the vat and left to drain in woven baskets without pressing, so the cheese keeps a high moisture content and takes the basket pattern on its surface. It is sold straight away, unripened.

steps.note: The curds are salted in the vat, with dry salt or a concentrated brine.
The curds are put into basket-weave moulds and drain overnight.
